validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED, real pipeline. P7766/P7767 represent the TWIN 36-inch trunklines that carry Hasbah (offshore Arabian Gulf) gas to the onshore Wasit gas plant. Independent corroboration: Oil & Gas Journal (Mar 2016, 'Twin 36-in. trunklines will carry production from the fields to the Wasit gas plant'; combined 2.5 bscfd from Hasbah + Arabiyah; field commissioned 2016) and Saudipedia ('pipelines, each with a diameter of thirty-six in' to the Wasit Gas Plant; Aramco-operated; first gas 2015) and offshore-technology.com Al Wasit Gas Program (36-in export pipeline, Wasit CPF 2.5 bcf/d, first gas Mar 2016). Not GEM-derived. CLASSIFICATION: CONFIRMED gas transmission trunkline (non-associated/sour gas to processing plant) - correct commodity and type. DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate of P7766 - sources explicitly describe TWO (twin/parallel) 36-in trunklines, so two GEM rows is correct; do not merge. DIAMETER 36 in: CONFIRMED high (OGJ '36-in', Saudipedia 'thirty-six in', offshore-technology '36in'). OWNER Aramco / DESTINATION Wasit: CONFIRMED high. SPEC CONCERNS: (1) Capacity = 1.00 MMcf/d is almost certainly a data error/placeholder - the Wasit plant processes 2.5 bcf/d (=2,500 MMcf/d) of combined Hasbah+Arabiyah gas; a single 36-in trunkline at 1 MMcf/d is physically nonsensical. No source supports 1 MMcf/d; declining to fabricate a per-line value. (2) LengthKnown = 80.00 km is unsupported - the original Wasit-program export pipeline is ~260 km offshore (380 km total incl. 120 km onshore), and the Hasbah Increment-II lines are 120 km and 126 km carbon-steel; no independent source gives 80 km, though no source pins the exact per-line length to the Wasit CPF either, so this is a lesser caveat. START 2017: caveat - first gas was 2015 (Saudipedia) / Mar 2016 (OGJ, offshore-technology); 2017 fits neither original commissioning nor the ~2019 expansion. Existing Status ref (al-jazirah.com/2019/.../fe9.htm) does not contain the value 'operating' on fetch (failed value check in worklist); replacing with OGJ + Saudipedia which confirm operation.

summary: P7767 (Hasbah-Wasit Pipeline 2) is real - one of twin 36-in Aramco trunklines Hasbah->Wasit; existence/diameter/owner/twin-line classification confirmed, but Capacity 1.00 MMcf/d is an implausible error and Length 80 km is unsupported (sources give 120/126/260 km).
